request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and storytelling, acoustic guitar, fiddle, banjo, upright bass, soft percussion, nostalgic and reverent mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Son of Malluch in the line of Merari
Ancestor to Ethan who sang with prayer
In David’s court the music stood
Where holy songs were understood

[Chorus]
My servant, my servant
Name that carries the weight of years
From the temple’s song to the valley’s dust
My servant, my servant

[Verse]
Kish stepped forward in the king’s decree
To cleanse the house and set it free
They carried out the unclean things
To where the Kidron river sings

[Chorus]
My servant, my servant
Name that carries the weight of years
From the temple’s song to the valley’s dust
My servant, my servant

[Bridge]
Son of Elam in the foreign land
Sent away by Ezra’s guiding hand
To keep the covenant pure and true
A faithful heart in the exile’s view

[Chorus]
My servant, my servant
Name that carries the weight of years
From the temple’s song to the valley’s dust
My servant, my servant

[Outro]
Three lives, one name, a servant’s call
Standing firm to answer God’s call
